items.html: And as for what it says that she nests in the three Sefirot of Beriah, when it would have been fitting to say that she nests in two Sefirot. But at first glance we may answer that the intention is the three Sefirot of the Throne, of which the above Ima is one of them. But the root of the matter is in what I have informed you above: that the three highest are KHB, but the squatting mother is not Bina but Tevuna, and this Tevuna is clothed in the three highest Sefirot, and then she nests in the Throne. And understand.
